item.title: UK will host the Women's World Cup in 2035
item.body: England, Northern Ireland, Scotland and Wales will host the 2035 Women's World Cup. It will be the first time the United Kingdom has hosted a football World Cup since 1966.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | ⚽ UK will host the Women's World Cup in 2035

England, Northern Ireland, Scotland and Wales will host the 2035 Women's World Cup. It will be the first time the United Kingdom has hosted a football World Cup since 1966.

Source: BBC Sport | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 23 November, 15:21
